scope: G05-current-operation-feedback RC04/RC40; current wallet operation messages and view changes.

independentBrowser.command: TMPDIR=/private/tmp NODE_BACKEND=js <pinned Node24> --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='new actions clear previous|completed refresh and import|changing action or account view|settled connection message|plaintext recovery warning|uncertain submission cannot resend|name availability|dialog selections and view' apps/rolling/wallet-panel.browser.test.mjs

checks.sourceBinding: Clean exact candidate; diff --check passed. Existing dependency link reused without mutation.

review: New work clears only obsolete operation error/notice/live text and their tagged DOM nodes before asynchronous work, so previous confirmation is absent during preparation and submission, not only after rerender.

Successful refresh clears temporary checking text. Import retains completed Recovery imported notice while temporary checking is in the live channel. Existing pending/unknown transaction presentation and retained intent/recovery guards remain unchanged.

Action/view selection clears stale feedback while preserving draft across views; same-action input errors remain editable and fixed safe feedback remains accessible. No fee, journal, transaction or contract logic changed.

Custody plaintext warning is separate untagged state and survives feedback cleanup. Existing account invalidation, focus restoration and pending no-resend paths are untouched; selected tests cover warning preservation, unknown failure fencing, dialog focus and uncertain submission recovery.

New tests exercise intermediate held prepare/submit boundaries and assert old confirmation disappears, then verify correct pending guidance and exact send count. No weakened assertions or removed acceptance cases.
limitations: Labelled browser UI tests establish presentation behavior, not new live chain acceptance. Prior live contract/GUI evidence remains separate.
No live service restart, transaction, build or private account file access; broader real-proof/browser-funding/release requirements remain open.
